title: Core: FLA round-trip preserves sound linkage
description: Test that a FlashDocument with frames that have sound linkage (SoundLinkage with libraryItemId, syncMode, repeatCount) round-trips through saveFla/loadFla. Build a doc with SoundItem in library and a frame with sound set to 'event' mode and 'start' mode. Verify all SoundLinkage fields are preserved exactly.
